cards.back:

cards.say: under the weather. Feeling slightly ill. I was under the weather, so I stayed in bed.

cards.back:

cards.back:

cards.say: spill the beans. To tell a secret by mistake. Please do not spill the beans about the surprise party.

cards.back:

cards.front: cost an arm and a leg

cards.back:

cards.back:

cards.back:

cards.say: look before you leap. Think carefully before you do something. Look before you leap, and check how deep the water is.

cards.front: two heads are better than one

Bahasa Indonesia: berpikir bersama lebih baik daripada sendirian
Example: Two heads are better than one, so let us solve this together.

cards.back:
What you do matters more than what you say.

Example: Actions speak louder than words, so help your friend now.
cards.say: actions speak louder than words. What you do matters more than what you say. Actions speak louder than words, so help your friend now.

cards.front: the early bird catches the worm

Example: The early bird catches the worm, so we left home at six.
cards.say: the early bird catches the worm. The person who starts early has the best chance. The early bird catches the worm, so we left home at six.

cards.front: every cloud has a silver lining

Example: Rain stopped our trip, but every cloud has a silver lining.
cards.say: every cloud has a silver lining. Even a bad situation has something good in it. Rain stopped our trip, but every cloud has a silver lining.

Bahasa Indonesia: jangan menilai sesuatu dari penampilannya
Example: Don't judge a book by its cover, as this old toy works.

cards.back:

cards.back:
